dialogue.content: （こんばんは。本日はよろしくお願いいたします。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I look forward to working with you today.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそよろしくお願いいたします☺️
dialogue.English: Thank you, likewise. ☺️

dialogue.content: （30分になったら始めさせていただきますね。）
dialogue.English: (We will begin at 30 minutes past.)

dialogue.content: （中高生の悩みでお願いしたいのですが、よろしいですか？）
dialogue.English: (I'd like to work with the concerns of a middle or high school student, is that okay?)

dialogue.content: 大丈夫です
dialogue.English: That's fine.

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。相談に来てくれてありがとうございます。本日はどのようなご相談ですか？
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming to talk today. What would you like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 家にも学校にも居場所がありません
dialogue.English: I feel like I don't have a place where I belong, either at home or at school.

dialogue.content: そうなんですね。とても苦しい状態ですね。もう少し詳しくお話を聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I see. That sounds like a very painful situation. Could you tell me a little more about it?

dialogue.content: 学校では仲間外れにされてるし
dialogue.English: At school, I'm being left out by my peers...

dialogue.content: はい。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 家では親が他のきょうだいのことと仕事で忙しい
dialogue.English: And at home, my parents are busy with their work and my other siblings.

dialogue.content: わたしはほっとかれてる
dialogue.English: I'm just left alone.

dialogue.content: うんうん。それは心が休まる場所がないですよね、、、
dialogue.English: Mm-hm. That means there's nowhere you can really feel at ease...

dialogue.content: わたしなんていないほうがいいんです
dialogue.English: It would be better if I weren't around.

dialogue.content: 誰にも必要とされてない
dialogue.English: No one needs me.

dialogue.content: そんな風に感じているのですね。大切なお話なので、もう少し質問させて頂きますね。
dialogue.English: So that's how you're feeling. This is a very important topic, so may I ask a few more questions?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: まず学校のことですが、仲間はずれというのはいつ頃から始まったのですか？
dialogue.English: First, about school—when did the exclusion start?

dialogue.content: ３ヶ月前とか
dialogue.English: Around three months ago, I think.

dialogue.content: 急にはじまったからはっきり覚えてません
dialogue.English: It started suddenly, so I don't remember clearly.

dialogue.content: 長い間耐えてきてるんだね。
dialogue.English: You've been enduring this for a long time.

dialogue.content: 耐えるしかない
dialogue.English: I have no choice but to endure it.

dialogue.content: 何かきっかけなどはあったのかな?
dialogue.English: Was there anything that might have triggered it?

dialogue.content: わかんない
dialogue.English: I don't know.

dialogue.content: 心当たりない
dialogue.English: I can't think of anything.

dialogue.content: 急にはじまって意味わかんない
dialogue.English: It started all of a sudden, and I don't understand why.

dialogue.content: そっかそっか。急に仲間はずれにされて、とても心が痛んだよね。
dialogue.English: I see. It must have been very painful to be left out all of a sudden.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: しんどいです
dialogue.English: It's really hard.

dialogue.content: とても辛いよね。
dialogue.English: That must be so difficult for you.

dialogue.content: ちなみに今の学年と性別を教えてもらえますか?
dialogue.English: By the way, could you tell me your current grade and gender?

dialogue.content: 中２
dialogue.English: Second year of middle school.

dialogue.content: 女子
dialogue.English: Female.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。仲間はずれにされてから、あなたはどのような行動をしたのか教えてもらえますか?
dialogue.English: Thank you. Can you tell me what action you've taken, if any, since you started being left out?

dialogue.content: なにも
dialogue.English: Nothing.

dialogue.content: 誰にもいってない
dialogue.English: I haven't told anyone.

dialogue.content: 言えない
dialogue.English: I can't tell anyone.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そうなんだね。なかなか、言いにくいことだよね。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm. I see. That's a very difficult thing to talk about, isn't it?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: わたしが我慢すればいいから
dialogue.English: Because if I just endure it, it'll be fine.

dialogue.content: そっかぁ。そのように思っているんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So that's how you feel about it.

dialogue.content: 迷惑かけたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to be a bother.

dialogue.content: うんうん。我慢するのは、あなたにとっては苦しいことではない？
dialogue.English: I understand. But isn't it painful for you to just endure it?

dialogue.content: 苦しいけど、誰かに言って迷惑かけるよりはいい
dialogue.English: It's painful, but it's better than bothering someone by telling them.

dialogue.content: 始めに話も出ていたけど、お母さんにも話はできなそうかな?
dialogue.English: You mentioned this at the start, but does it feel hard to talk to your mother about it?

dialogue.content: できない
dialogue.English: I can't.

dialogue.content: 忙しいし、いじめられてるって知られたくない
dialogue.English: She's busy, and I don't want her to know I'm being bullied.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そうなんだね、知られるのも嫌なんだね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you don't want her to know, either.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 心配かけたくないし、悲しいませたくないです
dialogue.English: I don't want to make her worry or make her sad.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。忙しいと余計にそんな気持ちになるよね、、、あなたは家でほっとかれてると言っていたけど、どのような環境なのかもう少し聞かせてもらえますか？
dialogue.English: I see. When she's busy, it's natural to feel that way even more... You mentioned that you feel left alone at home. Could you tell me a little more about that environment?

dialogue.content: 両親は共働きなので忙しいです
dialogue.English: My parents both work, so they're busy.

dialogue.content: 姉と妹の世話もあって忙しいからわたしはほっとかれてます
dialogue.English: They're also busy taking care of my older and younger sisters, so I'm left alone.

dialogue.content: 真ん中っこなんてそんなもんですよぬ
dialogue.English: That's just how it is for a middle child.

dialogue.content: ね
dialogue.English: Right?

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。あなたは、ほっとかれていると感じで辛いな、と思った時はどのように過ごしているのですか。
dialogue.English: I see. When you feel down because you feel left alone, how do you spend your time?

dialogue.content: テレビみたりYouTubeみたり気を紛らわしてます
dialogue.English: I distract myself by watching TV or YouTube.

dialogue.content: うんうん。ご自身で工夫してるんですね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you're finding your own ways to cope.

dialogue.content: 親が大変なのはわかるから
dialogue.English: Because I know my parents are having a hard time.

dialogue.content: うんうん。あなたは、とても思いやりのある方ですね。でも、今日、ここに来てくれたのは少しでも今の状況を変えたかったのかな?
dialogue.English: I understand. You're a very considerate person. But I wonder, did you come here today because you wanted to change your current situation, even just a little?

dialogue.content: いままで誰にもいえなくて
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to tell anyone until now.

dialogue.content: うんうん。
dialogue.English: Mmm-hmm.

dialogue.content: 言わなくてもわたしの中で消化できればいいか我慢すればいいかって思ってました
dialogue.English: I thought it would be fine if I could just process it on my own or put up with it without saying anything.

dialogue.content: けどやっぱり辛くなってきて
dialogue.English: But after all, it's just getting too painful.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。
dialogue.English: I see.

dialogue.content: 友達の前でも家族の前でも辛くないフリするの疲れちゃいました
dialogue.English: I'm tired of pretending I'm okay in front of my friends and family.

dialogue.content: ここで、今までのお話を少し整理させてもらってもいいですか？
dialogue.English: Would it be alright if I take a moment to summarize what we've discussed so far?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: ありがとう。
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: あなたは、学校で3ヶ月前位から仲間はずれにされている。突然で理由も分からない。
dialogue.English: You've been excluded at school for about three months. It started suddenly, and you don't know why.

dialogue.content: 家でもご両親が共働き、お姉さん、妹さんのお世話で忙しく、ほっとかれていると感じている。
dialogue.English: At home, you feel left alone because your parents both work and are busy taking care of your older and younger sisters.

dialogue.content: 今までは、誰にも言わなくてもご自身の中で消化できれば我慢すればよいと思っていたが、辛くないフリをするのも疲れてきた。
dialogue.English: Until now, you thought it would be fine to just endure it and process it on your own without telling anyone, but you've grown tired of pretending that you're not in pain.

dialogue.content: どうでしょうか？
dialogue.English: Does that sound right?

dialogue.content: そんなかんじです
dialogue.English: That's about right.

dialogue.content: うんうん。今の状況を少しでも変えられるように、一緒に考えていきたいと思うのだけど、どうかな?
dialogue.English: I see. I'd like for us to think together about how we might be able to change this situation, even just a little. How does that sound?

dialogue.content: ありがとうございます
dialogue.English: Thank you.

dialogue.content: まず、誰にも話せない状態が辛くなってきているということで、例えば学校で話しやすい先生（カウンセラーの先生、保健室の先生）はいたりしますか？
dialogue.English: First, since not being able to talk to anyone has become difficult, are there any teachers at school you might feel comfortable talking to, like a school counselor or the school nurse?

dialogue.content: 学校にカウンセラーいるのかな？
dialogue.English: I wonder if my school even has a counselor.

dialogue.content: 先生たちにも知られたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want the teachers to know either.

dialogue.content: どうせ助けてくれない
dialogue.English: They wouldn't help me anyway.

dialogue.content: そうなんだね。そんな風に思うのは、今まで何かあったのかな?
dialogue.English: I see. Has something happened in the past that makes you feel that way?

dialogue.content: 学校荒れてるから、いじめより大変な問題いっぱいあるから
dialogue.English: My school is pretty rough, so there are a lot of bigger problems than bullying.

dialogue.content: 信用できる人いないんです
dialogue.English: There's no one I can trust.

dialogue.content: うんうん。そしたら、家族以外では親戚の方などで話せそうな人はいるかな?
dialogue.English: I understand. In that case, besides your family, are there any relatives you might be able to talk to?

dialogue.content: いません
dialogue.English: No.

dialogue.content: 小学校の頃のお友達とかはどうかな?
dialogue.English: What about friends from elementary school?

dialogue.content: 友達もみんな上辺
dialogue.English: All my friends are superficial.

dialogue.content: （時間になりましたので、終了させて頂きますね。途中になってしまい、すみません。）
dialogue.English: (Our time is up, so we'll have to end here. I'm sorry for stopping in the middle.)

dialogue.content: とんでもないです☺️お疲れ様でした。
dialogue.English: Not at all. ☺️ Thank you for your time.

dialogue.content: （ありがとうございました）
dialogue.English: (Thank you very much.)

dialogue.content: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.English: Thank you very much as well.

dialogue.content: それでは、失礼いたします。
dialogue.English: Well then, goodbye.
